title: Personal Training Packages: loyalty bonus eligibility, trainer no-show credit, bundled nutrition consults, and rehab clearance by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states, for every tier, whether the tier is eligible for a goodwill loyalty bonus session, the number of sessions credited back to the package if the assigned trainer fails to show, the number of nutrition consult sessions bundled free with the package, and whether a documented medical clearance is required before a rehabilitation-focused session may be booked. When a loyalty bonus session is actually owed and credited is stated in the loyalty-bonus documents, not here.

## Tier reference table

| Tier | Eligible for the loyalty bonus session | Sessions credited on a trainer no-show | Nutrition consult sessions bundled free | Medical clearance required for a rehab session |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Single Session Pack | Yes | 1 | 0 | No |
| 5-Session Starter Pack | Yes | 1 | 0 | No |
| 10-Session Value Pack | Yes | 1 | 0 | No |
| 20-Session Performance Pack | Yes | 1 | 1 | No |
| Unlimited Monthly Coaching | No | 1 | 0 | No |
| Elite Specialty Coaching | Yes | 1 | 2 | Yes |

## Points of reference
Unlimited Monthly Coaching is the sole tier of Personal Training Packages not eligible for the loyalty bonus session; every other tier is eligible. Every tier credits exactly 1 session back to the package if its assigned trainer fails to show. Only the two highest tiers bundle free nutrition consult sessions: 1 on 20-Session Performance Pack and 2 on Elite Specialty Coaching, which also allows rehabilitation-focused sessions and is the only tier requiring a documented medical clearance before one may be booked; no other tier requires that clearance, since no other tier allows a rehabilitation-focused session type.
